sentences.en: House prices have remained static for several months.
sentences.zh: 房价连续几个月保持不变。

sentences.en: The population of this town has been static for the last ten years.
sentences.zh: 这个城镇的人口在过去十年中一直保持稳定。

sentences.en: These hiking clothes have made me an extremely dangerous source of static electricity.
sentences.zh: 这些徒步旅行的衣服让我成了一个极其危险的静电来源。

senses.zh: 静电；静电干扰；(猛烈的)反对或抨击
